# Installation

The setup script creates symbolic links to the appropriate locations in your
home directory. It is safe to run multiple times.

```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KauanCarvalho/.dotfiles/main/bin/setup.sh)"
```

> ⚠️ Review the script before running it if you want to understand or customize
> the symlink strategy.

---

## Requirements

- Debian-based Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, antiX)
- `git`
- `zsh`
- `tmux`
- `neovim`
- `claude`
- `kitty`

Some features also rely on common CLI tools such as:
- `fzf`
- `fd`
- `bat`

---

## Cleanup

Removes backup files generated by editors or tools.

```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KauanCarvalho/.dotfiles/main/bin/clean_backups.sh)"
```
